subject: Post-demo: POC kickoff proposal & success criteria (ProofPoint AI)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Rosen <ava.rosen@proofpointai.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@proofpointai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: POC kickoff proposal & success criteria (ProofPoint AI)

Thanks again for your time today — appreciated the candid priorities. Quick recap + a proposed POC plan so we can lock dates and owners. Attaching a one-tab timeline and a light risk register for your review (ProofPoint_POC_Timeline.xlsx, SLA_Risk_Register.pdf).

Objective (what success looks like):
- Validate Redwood inference end-to-end for your semantic search + retrieval flow on a subset of 10M docs.
- Business success metric: F1 for intent classification >= 0.87 on the evaluation set; average latency (p50) < 80ms, p95 < 250ms for production-like queries.
- Operational success: token throughput to sustain 2k QPS bursts without dropping requests; visibility into per-route cost and latency in Console.

Proposed POC structure (6 weeks):
1) Week 0 (Kickoff, 3 days): access, SSO + KMS handshake, dataset sampling, test plan sign-off.
2) Week 1-2 (Integration): model selection, SDK wiring, prefix caching for search, initial correctness checks.
3) Week 3-4 (Load & tuning): run synthetic load, adjust batching/quantization profile, capture latency/cost tradeoffs.
4) Week 5 (Evaluation): run evaluation suite (held-out queries), compute metrics, run edge-case prompts.
5) Week 6 (Review & next steps): executive demo, SOW/Migrate recommendation, and optional extension.

Owners:
- Redwood: Jordan Blake (eng contact / PM) — kickoff, timeline, executive updates.
- Redwood SE: Ben Carter — integration assistance, evaluation harness, and runbook.
- ProofPoint: Ava Rosen — product lead & decision owner; Liam Chen — infra lead for KMS/network access.

Open questions for you (can you confirm by Tue?):
- Which dataset slice should we use for the evaluation set? (example: "legal" + "support")
- Do you prefer Hosted trial (fastest on-boarding) or Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput & cost)?
- Any compliance requirements beyond SOC2 we should pre-load (PCI, HIPAA)?

Next steps I suggest:
- You confirm dataset slice + SSO contact.
- We schedule a 30-min kickoff next Wed/Thu (I proposed slots in the attached timeline).
- Ben will open a secure upload repo once we have IAM details.

If that all sounds good I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and a short pre-kickoff checklist.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference — Inference that just works

(attachments: ProofPoint_POC_Timeline.xlsx, SLA_Risk_Register.pdf)

From: Ava Rosen <ava.rosen@proofpointai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@proofpointai.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: POC kickoff proposal & success criteria (ProofPoint AI)

Jordan — thanks for the detailed plan and quick turnaround. High level, we’re aligned and would like to proceed with a POC, with a few adjustments and asks up front: 

1) Security/compliance: we need your SOC 2 report and a short summary of data residency controls. Also confirm KMS options (AWS KMS preferred).
2) Success metric tweak: for our production SLA we’ll need p99 < 200ms in addition to the p95 target you called out. Can you confirm whether that is feasible in a hosted trial vs dedicated?
3) Cost transparency: during the POC can you provide an estimated token-cost burn and a short forecast for scaling to production?

We can provide the evaluation set: start with the "support" slice (approx 120k docs) and a 5k-query evaluation set.

Schedule: Thu 20 May at 10:00 PT works for a kickoff. I’ll get our SRE (Liam) to share SSO/KMS contacts in a separate email.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Rosen | Head of Product, ProofPoint AI
ava.rosen@proofpointai.com | +1 (617) 555-0890

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Rosen <ava.rosen@proofpointai.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@proofpointai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: POC kickoff proposal & success criteria (ProofPoint AI)

Thanks Ava — great to hear. Quick answers inline and a small update to the plan: 

- SOC2 + evidence: we will share our latest SOC2 report (v2) and an export of audit log retention settings. I’ll attach a pointer to the secure folder before kickoff.
- KMS/SSO: we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS; SSO via SAML (IdP metadata exchange at kickoff). Liam — we’ll need an IAM contact for the upload repo and a ping to your networking team for the narrow egress rule.
- p99 target: p99 < 200ms on a Hosted trial is achievable for small query sizes but depends on burst shaping; Dedicated capacity gives more consistent p99 at scale. For the POC I recommend we run a two-week hosted integration, then a 2-week dedicated window to collect p99/p95 under realistic load — this will let us compare cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Cost forecast: Ben will produce a 3-scenario cost sheet (hosted baseline / dedicated moderate / dedicated peak) before the kickoff.

Updated milestone:
- Wed 19 May: secure folder + SOC2 pointer posted; Ben to share cost scenarios.
- Thu 20 May 10:00 PT: kickoff (confirming).
- Fri 21 May: upload of 120k "support" slice to secure repo; Ben will validate ingestion.

Action owners:
- Jordan: schedule kickoff, share SOC2 pointer, exec summary.
- Ben: cost scenarios, evaluation harness, runbook.
- ProofPoint: Ava — evaluation set; Liam — IAM/KMS contact + network rules.

Links: HubSpot deal is PLG-2027-0456 (I added the POC line item). If we move to an enterprise contract after the POC we can fast-track MSA signatures — I’ve included a DocuSign MSA link below for legal to review in parallel.

Doc links (for your team):
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/PLG-2027-0456
- Prelim MSA: https://www.docusign.com/psi/MSA-Redwood-PLG-2027
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExampleSharedDrive/ProofPoint-POC

I’ll ping calendar invite for Thu 20 at 10:00 PT. Looking forward to running this.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
